disableHistory.title: Turn off local history
disableHistory.description: No run history is kept with saved queries, and the extension never saves Query Studio runs, Content Builder email versions or Automation Studio activity versions, whatever the user's settings say.

disableShare.title: Turn off query sharing
disableShare.description: Hides Share, so no SQL is ever sent to the share service, and opened share links are not imported.

disableFeedback.title: Turn off the feedback form
disableFeedback.description: Hides Send feedback, so nothing is sent to the feedback service.

disableFeedbackMetadata.title: Turn off technical details in feedback
disableFeedbackMetadata.description: The feedback form never offers to include technical details (version, browser, page, error codes).

disableScreenshots.title: Turn off screenshots in feedback
disableScreenshots.description: The feedback form never offers to attach a screenshot.

disableContacts.title: Turn off the Contacts page
disableContacts.description: Hides Data > Contacts, and the extension stops reading the request headers Contact Builder's own page sends (needed only for that page).

disableDiagramforce.title: Turn off Open in Diagramforce
disableDiagramforce.description: Hides Open in Diagramforce, which sends a query's table and column names to diagramforce.com.
